The Cardinal were led by second year head coach [[Johnny Dawkins]], and played their home games at [[Maples Pavilion]] as a member of the [[Pacific-10 Conference]]. ==Previous season== The [[2008–09 Stanford Cardinal men's basketball team|Cardinal]] started the year off strong starting 10–0 in non-conference play but couldn't keep up in conference play ending up under .500. In the [[2009 Pacific-10 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-10 tournament]] they received a #9 seed and would win in the first round against [[2008–09 Oregon State Beavers men's basketball team|Oregon State]] In the second round the Cardinal faced #1 seed [[2008–09 Washington Huskies men's basketball team|Washington]] but lost 85–73. Stanford received a bid to the [[2009 College Basketball Invitational|College Basketball Invitational]] as a #1 seed in the Midwest and a first round opponent of Boise State. After the win against Boise State, Stanford hit the road and traveled to Wichita, Kansas to face the [[2008–09 Wichita State Shockers men's basketball team|Shockers]] and would come out with a 70–56 victory. With the Semifinals being reseeded, the Cardinal would face Pac-10 foe, for the fourth time in the season, Oregon State.
